population.kidComparison: About 1 out of every 200 people on Earth lives here, spread across the second-largest country in the world.

geography.climate: Varies from temperate in the south to subarctic and arctic in the north, with cold snowy winters across much of the country.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

flag.description: Two vertical red bars framing a white square with a red 11-pointed maple leaf in the center.

anthem.title: O Canada
anthem.summary: Adopted in 1980, celebrating the country's vast northern landscape and freedom.

exploration.didYouKnow: Canada has more lakes than the rest of the world's lakes combined—over two million of them!

regionalTraits: Carries a well-worn hockey puck as a lucky charm
Always orders a double-double coffee before boarding a flight
Wears a wool toque even indoors
Knows the tide schedule for the Bay of Fundy by heart
